  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês
  • Programa de indicações com premiação
  • Licença maternidade de 180 dias e paternidade de 20 dias
  • Acesso às plataformas de aprendizado (NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy – +80 mil cursos)
  • GetVibes: programa de escuta ativa com foco em melhoria contínua


O que esperar desta posição:

Você atuará como referência técnica no desenvolvimento de soluções avançadas de Inteligência Artificial, sendo responsável por projetar, desenvolver e otimizar agentes inteligentes que serão o núcleo de um assistente digital no contexto de cartões.

A posição envolve a criação de fluxos complexos de interação, orquestração de Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) e integração com múltiplos sistemas, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das soluções.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento de soluções em Inteligência Artificial
  • Proficiência em Python
  • Experiência com frameworks de agentes como LangChain e/ou LangGraph
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em LLMs e NLP (Processamento de Linguagem Natural)
  • Experiência com:
  • Prompt engineering
  • Fine-tuning de modelos
  • Experiência com integração via APIs REST
  • Vivência com construção de arquiteturas escaláveis


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com bibliotecas como Hugging Face, TensorFlow ou PyTorch
  • Conhecimento em MLOps
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes
  • Vivência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure )
  • Experiência com padrões de integração como MCP
  • Atuação com assistentes conversacionais ou agentes autônomos

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor RPA Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico, integrando um time de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.

Essa pessoa atuará de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a revisão da documentação funcional, avaliação de complexidade, suporte ao design e arquitetura da solução, desenvolvimento das automações, sustentação, monitoramento, implantação em produção e apoio ao período de hypercare.

Além disso, será treinada em nosso framework proprietário e metodologia de Hyperautomação SmartBPA®, que cobre toda a jornada — do Discovery à implementação do COE.

Como parte da equipe de Intelligent Automation, você colaborará com times multidisciplinares para entregar automações robustas, seguras, escaláveis e de alta qualidade.

O que buscamos

  • Profissional sênior, com forte experiência em desenvolvimento e sustentação de automações.
  • Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e com visão de qualidade e governança.
  • Alguém que gosta de atuar em ambientes que valorizam competência, transparência e confiança.
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente iniciativas, apoiar decisões de arquitetura e orientar membros do time.

Responsabilidades

  • Revisar documentação funcional, apoiar estimativas e propor melhorias.
  • Desenvolver, implantar, monitorar e sustentar automações no Automation Anywhere A360.
  • Construir e manter componentes reutilizáveis, boas práticas e padrões internos.
  • Integrar automações com APIs, bancos de dados, serviços corporativos e soluções de GenAI/ML e IDP.
  • Atuar em projetos de migração de versões, refactoring ou atualizações de arquitetura A360.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos de solução garantindo performance, segurança e compliance.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento do framework e processos internos de automação.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, análise raiz de incidentes e melhorias de estabilidade.
  • Apoiar testes integrados, homologação e hypercare de novas entregas.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Tecnologia, Engenharia, Sistemas ou Administração.
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência prática com Automation Anywhere (preferencialmente).
  • Certificações Automation Anywhere Advanced e Master. (Obrigatório)

Experiência sólida em:

  • Sustentação e monitoramento de automações (Fila, Control Room, logs, dashboards).
  • Integração via APIs, bancos de dados e aplicações corporativas.
  • Desenvolvimento e depuração de workflows complexos.
  • Implementação de tratativas robustas de erro e resiliência.
  • Documentação PDD e SDD.
  • Uso de frameworks e boas práticas.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente pequenos times ou células de sustentação.

Conhecimentos Diferenciais

  • Experiência com AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Domínio de produtos adicionais Automation Anywhere:
  • IA Agents
  • IA Studio
  • Document Automation
  • Enterprise Knowledge
  • Conhecimento em Python, VBScript ou JavaScript.
  • Experiência com GenAI, Machine Learning e IDP integrado a processos automatizados.
  • Outras certificações na área de automação inteligente, RPA, IA ou arquitetura.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Kotlin SR | Aceitação PJ
description:
Conheça melhor a unidade de negócio que essa vaga pertence:


A BU de Banking é especializada em oferecer soluções financeiras customizadas. Combinando expertise financeira com tecnologia avançada, visa facilitar operações diárias, otimizar a gestão financeira e apoiar o crescimento sustentável das empresas, garantindo sempre uma experiência segura, eficiente e personalizada.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora com experiência em Kotlin para integrar nosso time. Procuramos alguém com paixão por tecnologia, vontade de aprender e colaborar para construir soluções inovadoras que gerem impacto no negócio e na experiência de nossos clientes.


Responsabilidade e atribuições:


  • Tenha paixão por tecnologia e se mantenha atualizado(a) sobre as novidades do setor;
  • Goste de aprender e trabalhar com diferentes tecnologias e linguagens;
  • Participe ativamente das rotinas do time, propondo e discutindo soluções que atendam aos objetivos do negócio;
  • Tenha um olhar crítico e senso de dono sobre o que criamos no dia a dia;
  • Acompanhe e utilize métricas e indicadores do time para identificar e propor melhorias, sustentabilidade e novas oportunidades;
  • Colabore na criação e evolução dos fluxos de trabalho do time, garantindo eficácia e eficiência;
  • Desenvolva, coloque em produção, monitore e mantenha a saúde dos softwares e serviços entregues;
  • Melhore continuamente as bases de código, equilibrando velocidade de entrega e qualidade;
  • Realize e aceite feedbacks como parte de um ambiente colaborativo e voltado ao crescimento;
  • Assuma o protagonismo do seu autodesenvolvimento e da evolução da sua carreira profissional.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Programação orientada a objetos;
  • Experiência com Java (21 ou 24)
  • Experiência com Kotlin;
  • Frameworks como Spring Boot, Spring Data, e uso de JPA;
  • Design de APIs REST;
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em princípios como SOLID, Clean Code e padrões de projeto;
  • Experiência com CI/CD e ferramentas de automação;
  • Testes unitários e de integração;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e conteinerização;
  • Familiaridade com mensageria (ex.: Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, SNS);
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência com controle de versão usando Git;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em sistemas distribuídos (OAuth, JWT, etc.);
  • Experiência em processos de Code Review para garantir qualidade e boas práticas.


O que oferecemos:

Saúde e Bem-estar

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa Lado a Lado, com apoio jurídico, social, psicológico e financeiro;
  • Wellhub.

Alimentação/ Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho:

  • Cartão de crédito PicPay Benefícios, com ampla aceitação, onde você recebe seu saldo de Alimentação/Refeição e Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho (de acordo com o seu contrato de trabalho).

Licença Paternidade e Maternidade:

  • Licença Maternidade estendida de 6 meses, e de Paternidade também estendida de 20 dias.
  • Programa \"Novo Ser\", que acompanha nossas mamães durante toda a gestação e no retorno da licença. Falando nisso, ao retornar da licença maternidade, as mamães ainda contam com a ajuda do Auxílio Creche e também os papais que possuem guarda unilateral ou compartilhada.

Reconhecemos resultados: PPR- Participação nos Resultados do PicPay.

title: Node.js Data Engineer (TypeScript) – Remote (Brazil)
description:
Position: Node.js Data Engineer (TypeScript)

Location: Remote – Brazil

Job Type: Contract


About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Node.js and TypeScript , along with experience in data engineering, database management, and data modeling .

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize scalable data solutions that support business and analytics needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Design, implement, and maintain databases and data pipelines .
  • Perform data modeling, data transformation, and system integrations .
  • Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and software engineers to deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize data workflows for performance and scalability .
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of software development experience with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, backend architecture, and data integration patterns .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment .
  • Excellent communication skills in English or Portuguese .

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ETL pipelines and data warehousing solutions .
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or REST API development .
  • Knowledge of data governance, data security, and compliance .

title: OpenClaw Trajectory Specialist - 65130
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical business problems.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly analytical professionals to join as S3 Annotators , responsible for producing and validating advanced OpenClaw trajectories for research-oriented tasks involving ambiguous goals, multi-step reasoning, and long-context workflows.


This role requires strong problem-solving ability, research thinking, and the capability to justify decisions while executing complex, multi-tool workflows used to train sophisticated AI agents.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and validate OpenClaw trajectories for complex, research-oriented tasks
  • Work on tasks such as data analysis, web research, and document synthesis
  • Operate under underspecified or ambiguous goals , making logical and defensible decisions
  • Use Python (notebooks, scripts) for data processing, automation, and analysis
  • Perform workflows spanning multiple tools, environments, and applications
  • Clearly document both what actions were taken and why they were taken
  • Review and improve trajectory quality for reasoning depth and correctness
  • Collaborate with teams to refine evaluation standards and annotation frameworks


Requirements:

  • Background in research, data science, engineering, or related fields (academic or industry)
  • 5+ years of experience in Python / Bash , including experience with notebooks and data wrangling
  • Experience with OpenClaw or similar advanced environments
  • Experience with web research, scraping tools, or data analysis workflows
  • Ability to articulate reasoning behind decisions and steps
  • Experience handling multi-step workflows across tools or platforms
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows


Nice to Have:

  • Academic research experience (thesis, publications, lab work )
  • Familiarity with evaluation methodologies or experimental design
  • Experience in AI evaluation, RLHF, or advanced annotation workflows


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 20 hours per week, with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 5 weeks; (expected start date is next week).
  • Location: Remote (India, Brazil, Mexico, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Egypt, Nigeria, Ghana, Turkey)


Evaluation Process:

  • Resume screening
  • Take home assessment (60 mins)



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Data Architect
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!


Somos uma consultoria de inovação e transformação digital e buscamos Data Architect para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Atuar na definição e evolução da arquitetura de dados e integrações, com foco em eficiência de custos em cloud (FinOps).

• Conduzir análises técnicas do ambiente atual (Azure), identificando ineficiências, gargalos e oportunidades de otimização.

• Liderar a estratégia de migração de pipelines ETL do Azure Data Factory para GCP, garantindo performance, escalabilidade e redução de custo.

• Atuar diretamente na construção e evolução de pipelines de dados, apoiando o time em decisões e implementações técnicas.

• Realizar root cause analysis (RCA) de problemas de performance, custo e disponibilidade, propondo soluções estruturais.

• Definir padrões de ingestão, processamento e consumo de dados, equilibrando custo, performance e complexidade.

• Definir a arquitetura-alvo de dados orientada à redução de custo e otimização de recursos em cloud.

• Garantir a correta escolha de tecnologias e abordagens (batch vs streaming, relacional vs não relacional, cache, etc.).

• Conduzir e suportar tecnicamente a migração de ETLs para GCP (ex: Dataflow, Composer, BigQuery, etc.).

• Atuar de forma hands-on na revisão e otimização de pipelines, queries e jobs.

• Trabalhar próximo ao time de engenharia para garantir execução técnica consistente e sustentável.

• Definir e acompanhar indicadores de eficiência (custo por pipeline, consumo de recursos, performance).

• Documentar decisões arquiteturais e criar base de conhecimento reutilizável.

• Apoiar priorização técnica junto ao Delivery e Produto, considerando impacto financeiro e operacional.

Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência sólida como Arquiteto de Dados ou Engenheiro de Dados Sênior com forte atuação arquitetural.

• Experiência prática com ambientes cloud (Azure e/ou GCP).

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração e ETL (Azure Data Factory, Airflow, etc.).

• Experiência com modelagem de dados e bancos relacionais e não relacionais.

• Experiência com pipelines de dados (batch e/ou streaming).

• Forte capacidade de análise de problemas (RCA) e identificação de gargalos técnicos.

• Experiência com otimização de queries, pipelines e uso de recursos em cloud.

• Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar tanto em definição quanto em execução técnica.

• Experiência prática com Python e PySpark para construção e otimização de pipelines de dados em larga escala.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer

C17 Lab - GTM Automation & Revenue Operations

Remote • Full-Time Contractor 


About C17 Lab

C17 Lab is a GTM automation and revenue operations agency that helps B2B companies generate qualified pipeline through outbound systems. We work with professional services, manufacturing, and B2B SaaS companies, running end-to-end outbound programs that consistently deliver meetings and revenue.


We don't use stale data. We don't rely on generic tools. We build our own. Our proprietary tools scrape LinkedIn and Google Maps directly, clean client CRMs at scale, and give clients real-time visibility into every campaign through a purpose-built portal. We're building the infrastructure to be the most reliable outbound partner in the market.


The Role

You'll be the first dedicated software engineer at C17 Lab, reporting to the CEO. Your job is to build, ship, and maintain the software products that power our client delivery and differentiate us from every other agency.


You'll own three products:


  • Fertile - Our lead data engine. Scrapes LinkedIn and Google Maps for fresh, verified business and contact data. Replaces stale third-party databases. You'll build and maintain scrapers that run 24/7, handle anti-detection, and deliver clean data at scale.
  • Sterile - Our CRM hygiene tool. Deduplicates, cleans, and enriches client CRM data programmatically. You'll build the logic that identifies duplicates, resolves conflicts, and writes clean data back without breaking anything.
  • Client Portal - An enterprise-grade dashboard where clients track campaign performance, view their pipeline, and access learnings. Role-based access, real-time stats from all of our sequencer and a roadmap view. You'll build it from the ground up.


What You'll Do Day-to-Day


  • Build and maintain web scrapers (LinkedIn, Google Maps) that deliver 1M+ leads/month with >95% data accuracy
  • Design and implement data pipelines that enrich, validate, and deduplicate contact/company records
  • Develop the client portal with authentication, role-based access, campaign dashboards, and real-time data from SmartLead and Clay APIs
  • Integrate with third-party platforms: SmartLead (email sequencing), Clay (enrichment), Salesforce, HubSpot, and client-specific tools
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and automated health checks across all systems - if something breaks at 2am, you know before anyone else
  • Write data validation logic that catches issues before they reach clients — wrong emails, dead businesses, duplicate records
  • Own deployment, infrastructure, and uptime for all C17 Lab internal tools
  • Collaborate with Utkarsh (Head of GTM Eng) on architecture decisions and with the GTM team on feature requirements


You're a Great Fit If You


  • Have 3-5+ years of software engineering experience with at least 2 years building data-intensive applications
  • You are ahead of every single AI trends - Claude Code, Cursor, Clawbot
  • Can write production-grade Python with async patterns, proper error handling, and logging
  • Have real experience building and maintaining web scrapers (not just tutorials — systems that ran in production for months)
  • Know your way around PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, query optimization, and data deduplication patterns
  • Can build functional frontend interfaces with React or Next.js (dashboards, data tables, auth flows)
  • Understand API design and integration: RESTful APIs, webhooks, rate limiting, retry logic
  • Have deployed and monitored applications in production (Docker, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure)
  • Are comfortable being the only engineer — you own the outcome, not just the code
  • Communicate clearly in English, both written (Slack, documentation) and verbal (team calls)
  • Thrive in a small, fast-moving team where shipping matters more than perfection


Bonus Points


  • Experience with CRM APIs (Salesforce, HubSpot) and understanding CRM data models
  • BigQuery or data warehouse experience for enterprise client reporting
  • Redis, Celery, or job queue systems for managing scraping at scale
  • Security experience: OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC, data encryption
  • Prior experience in an agency, lead generation, or B2B SaaS environment


What We Offer


  • Full ownership of C17 Lab's product engineering - your code directly drives company revenue
  • Direct access to the CEO and Head of GTM Engineering - no layers of management or politics
  • A company building toward $10M revenue
  • Radical transparency - you'll always know how your work impacts clients and the business
  • Flexibility on location and schedule, with accountability on output and reliability


Compensation

Competitive contractor rate based on experience and location. We're looking for the right person, not the cheapest one. If you're exceptional, the compensation will reflect that.


How to Apply

Send us:


  • A brief intro (who you are, what you've built, why this role)
  • A link to your GitHub or portfolio showing real projects (not just coursework)
  • One example of a scraper, data pipeline, or internal tool you built and maintained in production


No cover letter needed. We care about what you've shipped, not what you've written about yourself.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer

C17 Lab - GTM Automation & Revenue Operations

Remote • Full-Time Contractor 


About C17 Lab

C17 Lab is a GTM automation and revenue operations agency that helps B2B companies generate qualified pipeline through outbound systems. We work with professional services, manufacturing, and B2B SaaS companies, running end-to-end outbound programs that consistently deliver meetings and revenue.


We don't use stale data. We don't rely on generic tools. We build our own. Our proprietary tools scrape LinkedIn and Google Maps directly, clean client CRMs at scale, and give clients real-time visibility into every campaign through a purpose-built portal. We're building the infrastructure to be the most reliable outbound partner in the market.


The Role

You'll be the first dedicated software engineer at C17 Lab, reporting to the CEO. Your job is to build, ship, and maintain the software products that power our client delivery and differentiate us from every other agency.


You'll own three products:


  • Fertile - Our lead data engine. Scrapes LinkedIn and Google Maps for fresh, verified business and contact data. Replaces stale third-party databases. You'll build and maintain scrapers that run 24/7, handle anti-detection, and deliver clean data at scale.
  • Sterile - Our CRM hygiene tool. Deduplicates, cleans, and enriches client CRM data programmatically. You'll build the logic that identifies duplicates, resolves conflicts, and writes clean data back without breaking anything.
  • Client Portal - An enterprise-grade dashboard where clients track campaign performance, view their pipeline, and access learnings. Role-based access, real-time stats from all of our sequencer and a roadmap view. You'll build it from the ground up.


What You'll Do Day-to-Day


  • Build and maintain web scrapers (LinkedIn, Google Maps) that deliver 1M+ leads/month with >95% data accuracy
  • Design and implement data pipelines that enrich, validate, and deduplicate contact/company records
  • Develop the client portal with authentication, role-based access, campaign dashboards, and real-time data from SmartLead and Clay APIs
  • Integrate with third-party platforms: SmartLead (email sequencing), Clay (enrichment), Salesforce, HubSpot, and client-specific tools
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and automated health checks across all systems - if something breaks at 2am, you know before anyone else
  • Write data validation logic that catches issues before they reach clients — wrong emails, dead businesses, duplicate records
  • Own deployment, infrastructure, and uptime for all C17 Lab internal tools
  • Collaborate with Utkarsh (Head of GTM Eng) on architecture decisions and with the GTM team on feature requirements


You're a Great Fit If You


  • Have 3-5+ years of software engineering experience with at least 2 years building data-intensive applications
  • You are ahead of every single AI trends - Claude Code, Cursor, Clawbot
  • Can write production-grade Python with async patterns, proper error handling, and logging
  • Have real experience building and maintaining web scrapers (not just tutorials — systems that ran in production for months)
  • Know your way around PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, query optimization, and data deduplication patterns
  • Can build functional frontend interfaces with React or Next.js (dashboards, data tables, auth flows)
  • Understand API design and integration: RESTful APIs, webhooks, rate limiting, retry logic
  • Have deployed and monitored applications in production (Docker, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure)
  • Are comfortable being the only engineer — you own the outcome, not just the code
  • Communicate clearly in English, both written (Slack, documentation) and verbal (team calls)

Bonus Points

  • Redis, Celery, or job queue systems for managing scraping at scale
  • Security experience: OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC, data encryption

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About:

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect, design, and implement backend systems and APIs using Java (Spring Boot/Spring Cloud) for AI-driven applications.
  • Collaborate with data science and ML teams to integrate machine learning models and pipelines into scalable backend services.
  • Develop and optimize microservices, ensuring low latency and high availability.
  • Implement data ingestion, transformation, and model-serving workflows in coordination with ML engineers.
  • Ensure seamless deployment of ML models through API endpoints and containerized environments.
  • Apply best practices for security, scalability, and reliability across distributed systems.
  • Optimize backend services for performance and cost efficiency in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and infrastructure as code.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (AI/ML specialization a plus).
  • 7+ years of professional backend development experience with Java.
  • Strong proficiency in Java (8 or higher) and frameworks such as Spring Boot or Spring Cloud .
  • Experience with RESTful API design , microservices architecture , and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
  • Proficient in Git , CI/CD pipelines , and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Understanding of Agile development principles and version control best practices.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with MLOps practices and CI/CD for ML pipelines.
  • Contributions to AI/ML-related open-source projects or research experience.


Benefits

- Full-time remote working within an international environment

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Analista Desenvolvedor Mainframe - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Analista Desenvolvedor Mainframe - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Profissional essencial para conectar a nova plataforma de IA aos sistemas transacionais legados de um banco, que são a base de dados e de regras de negócio. Será responsável por desenvolver, manter e otimizar rotinas em ambiente Mainframe para garantir a troca de informações segura e performática.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagem: Proficiência avançada em COBOL, incluindo desenvolvimento para processamento em lote (Batch) e online (CICS) .
  • Ambiente Mainframe: Experiência com JCL para controle de jobs, TSO/ISPF e ferramentas de depuração .
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos de dados de mainframe, principalmente DB2, incluindo a escrita e otimização de consultas SQL.
  • Integração: Capacidade de analisar e modificar sistemas legados para expor dados e funcionalidades para os novos sistemas de IA.
  • Arquivos: Experiência com arquivos sequenciais e arquivos VSAM .
  • Análise de Sistemas: Habilidade analítica para entender lógicas de negócio complexas presentes no código legado.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Proofreader (TEMP CONTRACT)
description:
Proofreader


LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.


As a Proofreader, you will work on a diverse range of immigration-related template, forms, and letters, applying a range of writing and editing skills to understand our clients' needs and ensuring our letters meet the highest quality standards. A Junior Proofreader must be proficient in basic and advanced grammar rules and understand how they are used within our style guides. Our ideal candidate is meticulous in reviewing copy, noting errors such as punctuation, spelling, and word usage, and knows how to check statements for accuracy.


This is a temporary contract role. The duration of the contract will be mid/end April 206 to end of June 2026. Working hours during this period will be Monday – Friday 9:00AM – 5:00PM Eastern Standard Time.


Main Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Review documents for grammar, spelling, and style
  • Fact-check dates and other statements for accuracy
  • Make corrections and suggest edits
  • Manage multiple proofreading projects and meet proofreading deadlines
  • Communicate effectively with the writers and other staff to ensure documents meet all company guidelines


Requirements:

  • A strong education background
  • English proficiency (speaking and writing)
  • Expert command of English grammar and punctuation
  • Exceptional fluency with Microsoft Word, including relevant shortcuts and advanced features like Paragraphs, Styles, Templates, and Mail Merge fields
  • Highly-focused and detail-oriented
  • Proven ability to multitask, exhibit flexibility, and remain responsive as demands change
  • Ability to work well in both independent and highly collaborative settings
  • Ability to excel in fast-paced work environment

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.



Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year
    • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.


    Hiring Process

    • Application review
    • Technical conversation
    • Architecture discussion
    • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
    • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: People Business Partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.


What You'll Do:

description:

Kyniska is a leading provider of innovative HR solutions, connecting talented individuals with exciting job opportunities worldwide. Every day, we help over 200,000 professionals achieve fulfilling careers tailored to their skills and aspirations. This is a full-time remote role for a Customer Service Technical Support professional.   • Problem-solving aptitude and a keen attention to detail, especially in handling technical customer issues.
  • A background in IT, technical support, or related fields is a valuable asset.
  • Experience using CRM or help desk software is a plus.

title: CUA Trajectory Specialist - 65129
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical business problems.


Role Overview:

We are looking for skilled professionals to contribute as S2 Annotators , responsible for producing and validating high-quality Computer-Use Agent (CUA) trajectories for developer-adjacent workflows. This includes tasks such as file operations, light scripting, API interactions, and browser automation.

This role requires a strong understanding of technical workflows, attention to detail, and the ability to translate natural language instructions into precise, step-by-step executable actions that can be used to train advanced AI systems.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create detailed, step-by-step positive CUA trajectories for technical tasks (e.g., file manipulation, scripting, API calls, browser-based workflows)
  • Break down natural language instructions into clear, verifiable actions
  • Validate and review trajectories for correctness, completeness, and reproducibility
  • Work within Linux desktop environments to execute and document workflows
  • Use scripting (Python/Bash) to simulate or validate task execution where required
  • Interact with tools and environments involving APIs, terminals, and browser automation
  • Collaborate with internal teams to refine task quality and annotation guidelines
  • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and high-quality standards across all annotations


Requirements:

  • 2–5 years of experience in software development, technical support, or similar technical roles
  • Strong familiarity with Linux environments and command-line operations
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language: Python or Bash
  • Ability to decompose complex instructions into structured, step-by-step workflows
  • Strong attention to detail in documenting technical processes
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows
  • Basic understanding of APIs, file systems, and developer tooling
  • Familiarity with OpenClaw or similar environments/tools


Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience in data annotation, RLHF, or SFT labeling workflows
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, REST APIs, or terminal-based automation
  • Experience working with browser automation tools or developer productivity tools
  • Background in evaluating or improving AI-generated outputs


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work with cutting-edge AI technology and contribute to next-generation systems
  • Flexible, remote work environment
  • Opportunity to collaborate with leading AI researchers and engineers
  • Competitive compensation based on your expertise
  • Long-term engagement opportunities


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 20 hours per week, with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 5 weeks; (expected start date is next week).
  • Location: Remote (India, Brazil, Mexico, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Egypt, Nigeria, Ghana, Turkey)


Evaluation Process:

  • Resume screening
  • Take home assessment (60 mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.


As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you’ll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You’ll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.


About iCore


iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We’re proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.


Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.


Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.


Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.


Objectives:


  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns


Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency
  • Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
  • Ability to pass job-specific assessments


Benefits:


Personal:

  • Be a valued leader, not just a trainer

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.


  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices , and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.


  • Work with a mission-driven team

You’ll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.


  • 100% remote – work from home

Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.


  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.


  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.


Professional:

  • Grow your training and leadership skills

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.


  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.


  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.


  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.


  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.


  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.


What you can expect from a career with our team!

  • Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
  • Work Setup: Fully remote position


You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously

title: Key Account Manager - Foco em Redes de Recarga
description:
Venha fazer parte da maior fabricante de medidores elétricos da América Latina!

Somos uma empresa de 95 anos que atua como provedora de tecnologia e soluções completas para o segmento de energia elétrica.

#VemSerNansen


Suas atividades serão:

  • Gestão de Relacionamento: Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com clientes estratégicos, atuando como ponto de contato principal.
  • Desenvolvimento de Negócios: Identificar oportunidades de crescimento dentro das contas existentes e propor soluções que agreguem valor.
  • Negociação e Contratos: Conduzir negociações comerciais, monitorar elaboração de propostas e monitorar processos de operações e pós-vendas.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Acompanhar indicadores de vendas
  • Integração Interna: Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de operações, marketing, pós vendas e financeiro para assegurar a execução eficiente das estratégias.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Mapear tendências, concorrência e oportunidades no setor de distribuição e recarga.


Esta vaga é afirmativa e extensiva a toda a diversidade de pessoas, seja pela sua cor, etnia, gênero, religião, deficiência, faixa etária ou orientação sexual.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Vivência em setores de distribuição
  • Experiência em gestão de indicadores de performance (KPIs) e relatórios estratégicos.
  • Participação em projetos de expansão de canais de distribuição ou integração de soluções de recarga.
  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica, Energia, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado / fluente.


Confira nossos benefícios:

️ Vale-refeição (VR)

title: Analista De Testes (IA) - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Analista De Testes (IA) - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Responsável por garantir não apenas a funcionalidade, mas também a inteligência, a ética e a confiabilidade dos modelos de IA. Irá desenvolver e executar estratégias de teste específicas para sistemas de IA, validando desde a qualidade dos dados até a precisão e o comportamento dos agentes.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Automação de Testes: Experiência consolidada em automação de testes para aplicações em ambiente Cloud .
  • Testes de IA/ML: Conhecimento em técnicas de teste para sistemas de IA, como avaliação de métricas de modelos (precisão, recall), teste de robustez, detecção de vieses (bias) e validação de pipelines de dados.
  • Ferramentas de QA: Familiaridade com frameworks de automação de testes (ex: Selenium, Cypress, Maestro, Appium), ferramentas de teste de API (ex: Postman) e testes de performance (ex: JMeter, K6).
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimentos básicos em bancos de dados SQL.
  • Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de entender a arquitetura de sistemas de IA para planejar testes em todas as camadas (dados, modelo, API, UI).
  • Mentalidade Analítica: Habilidade para pensar criticamente sobre os possíveis pontos de falha em um sistema inteligente e criar cenários de teste que explorem esses limites.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

Responsável por garantir não apenas a funcionalidade, mas também a inteligência, a ética e a confiabilidade dos modelos de IA. Irá desenvolver e executar estratégias de teste específicas para sistemas de IA, validando desde a qualidade dos dados até a precisão e o comportamento dos agentes.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Automação de Testes: Experiência consolidada em automação de testes para aplicações em ambiente Cloud .
  • Testes de IA/ML: Conhecimento em técnicas de teste para sistemas de IA, como avaliação de métricas de modelos (precisão, recall), teste de robustez, detecção de vieses (bias) e validação de pipelines de dados.

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.


Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.


This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.


Pay

$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.


If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager
description:
About us:

At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote roles with US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.


Overview:

One of our fast-growing US clients is looking for a versatile SEO marketer with a strong Growth foundation and proven experience running B2B campaigns. In this role, you'll own the search strategy, drive measurable pipeline growth, and support high-impact marketing initiatives across the funnel.


You’ll spend about 60% of your time on SEO (including AI-driven SEO) and 40% on broader growth projects . From improving rankings on Google and LLMs to launching targeted ads on LinkedIn and Google, you’ll be responsible for identifying the biggest opportunities, creating a plan, and executing quickly.


This is a high-agency, high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants room to grow.


Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve the SEO strategy to improve rankings, visibility, and conversions across both Google search and large language models.
  • Conduct keyword research, optimize on-page content, lead technical SEO improvements, and run AI-SEO experiments.
  • Report weekly on performance, key insights, and recommended actions.
  • Launch, manage, and optimize B2B campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads to drive qualified leads.
  • Write high-converting copy for ads, landing pages, and growth experiments.
  • Support awareness and demand-gen initiatives, including webinar promotion, content refreshes, and campaign execution.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to execute cross-functional growth projects.


Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2B environments.
  • Proven success in SEO, including technical SEO, content optimization, and AI-driven SEO strategies.
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads .
  • Proficiency with SEO tools such as SEMrush , Ahrefs , or equivalents.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong copywriting ability, especially for ads and landing pages.
  • High ownership mindset, you prioritize effectively, execute independently, and move fast.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Startup experience or comfort operating in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page optimization.

title: Remote Wholesale Trade Specialist - 65113
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role overview:

We are looking for wholesale and sales domain experts (5+ years experience) to create real-world, profession-based prompts and tasks. The role involves creating high quality prompts and documents to evaluate model responses on day-to-day work in wholesale, sales operations, and distribution environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create realistic, first-person prompts based on actual job workflows
  • Design tasks that reflect real-world wholesale and sales scenarios
  • Select and use relevant public data/documents as input files
  • Ensure prompts are clear, specific, and aligned to the occupation
  • Review tasks for accuracy, completeness, and real-world relevance


Requirements:

  • Degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or related field
  • Strong understanding of real-world workflows in your profession
  • Ability to convert work scenarios into structured, high-quality prompts


Who can Apply :

We are open to many experts within wholesale and sales (including but not limited to): Sales Representatives, Wholesale & Manufacturing (Non-Technical), Sales Managers, Sales Representatives, Wholesale & Manufacturing (Technical/Scientific), First-Line Supervisors of Non-Retail Sales Workers, Order Clerks.


Terms of Contract :

  • Opportunity is for a project that is ~2 week duration with potential extension



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Salesforce Architect
description:
Position : Salesforce Architect

Openings : 1

Duration : 12month contract (potential to extend)

Start Date : Mid April

Interview Process : 2 rounds virtual

PR: $20-35 an hour USD

(onboarding as AOR)

Location : Brazil (remote)

Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years of experience as an Architect
  • Coming from an admin/engineer technical background
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce product
  • Sales Cloud
  • Service Cloud
  • Marketing Cloud
  • Experience with the newest version (Agentforce Marketing)
  • Able to work EST time zone

Day to Day:

We are looking for a strong Salesforce Architect to support one of our clients. Our client has been using an in-house built CRM tool for a while, and currently in the process of implementing Salesforce. This implementation is set to be completed mid-year, and they would like to bring on a Salesforce Architect to not only assist with the implementation but help oversee the Salesforce environment post implementation. This individual will mainly be responsible for true architect functions but will need to also come from a hands-on technical background in salesforce to assist the team of admins. This architect will be responsible for the following:

  • Product road mapping
  • Advising on best practices, standards, and architectural guardrails
  • Supporting the technical team as an escalation POC
  • Working cross functionally with the business teams + technical teams
  • Translate business needs/processes into technical architecture and system design

title: Engenheiro de software júnior

#LI-LR1


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Escrever teste de unidade e integração
  • Garantir a qualidade do produto de software em parceria com as pessoas de QA
  • Manter o seu processo de trabalho sempre aderente a sua realidade recebendo o suporte do time de agilidade
  • Monitorar o software em produção em parceria com o time de Devops
  • Realizar a gestão das dívidas técnicas juntamente com Agilista de squad e PM
  • Realizar manutenções corretivas no software
  • Desenvolver software seguindo os padrões de segurança da informação

  • Manter e evoluir os processos de desenvolvimento

  • Técnicas de programação
  • Arquitetura de software

  • Oracle e MongoDB

  • REST
  • Git
  • Engenharia de software ágil

  • Testes (JUnit / Mockito)
  • Métodos Ágeis e Kanban

  • Conhecer versões mais antigas de Java
  • Ter conhecimento em Angular / React
  • JSP / Struts
  • Comunicação SOAP

No Sicredi você vai ter:


14º e 15º salários fixos;

Participações nos Resultados (conforme a senioridade);

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico sem coparticipação,

Programas de bem-estar com Wellhub (antiga Gympass), Nutrição, Psicologia, Laboral, Massagem, Grupo de corrida e academia local;

Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição – com flexibilidade de % nos cartões VA/VR, sem coparticipação;

Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

Auxílio creche ou babá para crianças até 6 anos e 11 meses;

Auxílio para filhos com deficiência, sem limite de idade;

Seguro de vida,

Previdência Privada até 8% do salário;

Plataforma de Treinamentos – Sicredi Aprende, com diversos cursos;

Carga horária de 40h semanais – Utilizando sistema de banco de horas;

Auxílio Teletrabalho (exceto para posições com atuação 100% presenciais).

title: Gerente de projetos de TI
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Gerente de projetos de TI


Atividades para contratação:


• Liderar tecnicamente a gestão de projetos de tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento entre estratégia de negócio, arquitetura de soluções e execução das entregas.

• Atuar como referência técnica para os times de projeto, apoiando na tomada de decisões relacionadas a arquitetura, integrações, dados e plataformas.

• Apoiar na definição de escopo técnico, planejamento e estimativas de projetos e iniciativas de inovação.

• Garantir que as entregas tecnológicas estejam aderentes às boas práticas de desenvolvimento, segurança, arquitetura e governança de TI.

• Atuar na interface entre áreas de negócio, times técnicos, fornecedores e parceiros tecnológicos.

• Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho dos projetos, riscos técnicos e evolução das entregas.

• Contribuir para a evolução das práticas de gestão de projetos e governança de tecnologia.


Qualidade técnicas:


• Conhecimento em gestão de projetos de tecnologia e transformação digital.

• Experiência com metodologias ágeis e híbridas (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, PMI).

• Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas, integrações via APIs e microsserviços.

• Experiência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

• Conhecimento em governança de TI e segurança da informação.

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday).

• Capacidade de avaliar soluções tecnológicas e orientar decisões técnicas em projetos.


Qualidade pessoais:

• Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar times multidisciplinares.

• Visão estratégica e capacidade de conectar tecnologia com objetivos de negócio.

• Boa comunicação e habilidade de traduzir temas técnicos para áreas não técnicas.

• Proatividade e senso de dono sobre as entregas e resultados.

• Capacidade analítica e foco em resolução de problemas complexos.

• Organização e habilidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

• Perfil colaborativo e orientado a melhoria contínua.


Experiência anterior: Experiência na liderança técnica de projetos de tecnologia ou transformação digital. Vivência na gestão de projetos complexos envolvendo múltiplas áreas e sistemas. Experiência em ambientes corporativos com integração de sistemas e APIs. Atuação em projetos de inovação, modernização de plataformas ou implantação de canais digitais.

Habilidades Técnicas:


- Gestão de Projetos

- Arquitetura de Sistemas

- Integrações via APIs

- Microsserviços

- AWS

- Azure

- GCP

- Governança de TI

- Segurança da Informação

- Jira

- Azure DevOps

- Monday

- áreas de negócio

- Tech Lead

- Liderança técnica

- Visão estratégica

- Boa comunicação

- Proatividade

- Perfil colaborativo

- Capacidade analítica

- foco em resolução de problemas

- Kanban

- PMI

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Transforme o futuro com a Minsait


Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma


Valores

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro


Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.




Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Responsabilidades:


Expertise em arquitetura AWS,

Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou CloudFormation preferencial),

Pipelines CI/CD,

Design de observabilidade e monitoramento,

Ajuste de desempenho e planejamento de capacidade,

Automação de tarefas operacionais,

Análise de tendências de incidentes e estratégias para redução do MTTR,

Metodologia de análise de causa raiz,

Melhores práticas de DevOps e SRE

Inglês Fluente - Reporte para EUA



Detalhe técnico necessário


Arquitetura AWS, Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou CloudFormation preferencial), Pipelines CI/CD, Melhores práticas de DevOps e SRE


Skills Comportamentais


Liderança Técnica

Alta capacidade de auto gerenciamento.

Saber definir padrões técnicos e boas práticas para o time.

Visão de Negócio

Entender a necessidade dos stakeholders e traduzi-la em soluções escaláveis.

Priorizar entregas de acordo com valor agregado ao negócio.

Comunicação Clareza ao explicar conceitos complexos a perfis não técnicos.

Documentação e storytelling com dados.

Resiliência e Ownership

Assumir a responsabilidade pelo ciclo de vida do dado (desde a ingestão até o consumo).

Resolver problemas em cenários de alta pressão.

Colaboração e Trabalho em Equipe Capacidade de trabalhar em squads multidisciplinares (com analistas, cientistas de dados, engenheiros de software).


Cultura DevOps Agile (Scrum ou Kanban)


TRABALHE NA MINSAIT


  • Modelo de contratação CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde subsidiado pela empresa para o titular.
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Saúde com desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Assistência Odontológica (opcional).
  • Vale Refeição no cartão Flash Benefícios.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional).
  • POP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal que visa oferecer suporte emocional e aconselhamento com orientação confidencial nas áreas psicológica, jurídica, financeira, social e pet sem custo para titular e dependentes legais.
  • Plataforma de Saúde Wellhub-Gympass (Acesso a mais de 700 academias em todo o Brasil com planos descontado em folha de pagamento).
  • Parcerias com grandes marcas de consumo.
  • Convênio com o SESC para titular e dependentes.
  • Convênios para descontos com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação) e escola de idiomas.
  • Seguro de vida em grupo.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade é um elemento-chave da nossa cultura: Igualdade de oportunidades, respeito pelas pessoas e não discriminação são princípios de atuação para todos os profissionais da Minsait. Integramos o Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index (GEI) 2021 em termos de diversidade e igualdade de gênero.
