title: Analista Sênior de IAM
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista Sênior de IAM (gestão de identidade e acesso)



Resumo:

Estamos buscando um Analista Sênior de IAM experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe de cibersegurança. Este profissional será responsável por criar processos, configurar ferramentas e aprimorar os assuntos de IAM de forma global.

O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outras frentes de segurança, infraestrutura, sistemas e equipes de negócios, avaliando as melhorias e implementações necessárias para a eficácia do Programa de IAM.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter processos de gestão de identidades e acessos, incluindo provisionamento, revogação e revisão periódica de privilégios;
  • Administrar e implementar ferramentas relacionadas à IAM garantindo funcionamento, confiabilidade e atendendo aos requisitos de segurança;
  • Criar, revisar e otimizar regras, perfis, grupos e políticas de acesso, assegurando a aplicação de princípio de privilégio mínimo e SoD (Segregação de Funções), para ambientes on prem e cloud;
  • Definir estratégia para integração de sistemas e aplicações às plataformas de IAM;
  • Colaborar com outros times para mapear processos de acesso, identificar riscos e sugerir implementações ou automações de controles;
  • Apoiar times internos na compreensão das práticas de gestão de identidades, acessos e requisitos de segurança relacionados;
  • Suportar processos de auditorias.




Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência:

  • Experiência de ao menos 5 anos atuando diretamente com temas ligados à IAM;
  • Formação Superior em Tecnologia da Informação/Segurança da Informação;
  • Conhecimento avançado em temas como AD/Entra ID, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, SSO, MFA, PAM, SoD, RBAC, princípio de menor privilégio e revisão de acessos;
  • Administração ou vivência em projetos de implementação de ferramentas de IDM(Identity Manager);
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Defender for Identity, e demais ferramentas de IAM para ambientes híbridos e multicloud (On Prem, Azure, AWS, GCP);
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento em normas e boas práticas de segurança da informação (ex: ISO 27001, NIST, etc).




Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações relevantes de fabricantes de soluções para IAM/PAM, exemplo:

(CyberArk, Senha Segura, BeyondTrust, SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft EntraID, etc).

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
Responsibilities

  • Meet quarterly and annual revenue goals according to the sales plan through a deep understanding of TopOn’s products and ad inventory.
  • You will interface, negotiate, and develop high-impact relationships with mobile game & app developers to build business partnerships and support company growth.

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Location / Remote: Remote -- Candidates who reside outside the United States will be considered.


Time Zone: Must be willing to work Eastern Timezone Hours


Communication : Only candidates with professional-level English proficiency will be considered.


Employment Type: 12-month contract (W-2, C2C).


Compensation: Up to 33 U.S. dollars per hour (depending on experience).


This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI-driven automation solutions. The Agentic Solutions Architect will play a hands-on role in architecting secure, scalable, and production-ready intelligent automation systems that integrate AI agents, enterprise platforms, APIs, and data systems. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, a strong understanding of automation architecture, and the ability to guide teams in implementing innovative AI solutions.


Responsibilities:


  • Architect enterprise-grade intelligent automation solutions integrating AI agents, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design and implement multi-step workflows involving AI agents, RPA bots, and enterprise applications.
  • Establish architecture patterns for orchestration, exception handling, approvals, and auditability.
  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform AI tools, including Copilot Studio and Power Automate.
  • Architect secure integrations between AI agents, automation platforms, and enterprise data systems, particularly Databricks.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams.
  • Evaluate emerging agent technologies and recommend best practices for adoption.
  • Develop repeatable architecture standards, patterns, and governance practices for AI automation.


Required Skills:


  • 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise automation architecture, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-driven or intelligent automation solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Copilot / Power Platform AI capabilities (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with Azure AI services or Microsoft AI Foundry.
  • Strong experience designing API-driven integrations and distributed automation architectures.
  • Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise data platforms, with a preference for Databricks.
  • Ability to design secure, scalable, and production-ready AI automation solutions.


Preferred Skills:


  • Experience with enterprise RPA platforms such as UiPath or similar.
  • Experience designing multi-agent workflows or human-in-the-loop automation systems.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Automation or AI Centers of Excellence.
  • Expertise in establishing architecture standards, reusable components, and automation governance frameworks.

title: Director of Marketing | Hotel Technology Experience Required
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next-generation, AI-native platform for the hospitality industry. Looking for a Director of Marketing who understands hotels, understands technology, and knows how to turn that knowledge into real growth.


This role is ideal for someone who has marketed to hotel decision-makers before and enjoys building campaigns, writing compelling content, and generating measurable demand.


About the Role

We’re building something special for the hotel industry, and we’re looking for a Director of Marketing who feels at home in the world of hotel technology.


If you’ve spent meaningful time marketing to hoteliers, understand how hotel decision-makers think, and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to create campaigns that drive pipeline, you’ll thrive in this role.


This is a hands-on, full-funnel leadership role responsible for building and scaling our marketing engine. You will oversee demand generation, product marketing, content creation, and go-to-market strategy while working closely with Sales to drive qualified leads and revenue growth.


The hospitality industry values clarity, trust, and solutions that make operations easier. We’re looking for someone who knows how to communicate exactly that.


What You’ll Be Doing

Develop a deep understanding of the hotel ecosystem, including independent hotels, management companies, and brand-affiliated properties.


Stay closely connected to the needs and priorities of hotel decision-makers such as:

  • General Managers
  • Directors of Sales and Marketing
  • Revenue Managers
  • Digital marketing leaders
  • IT leaders


Use these insights to shape messaging, positioning, and campaigns that resonate with hotel operators.


Owning the Marketing Engine

Build and manage the full marketing funnel—from awareness through lead generation, nurturing, and conversion to sales.


Key areas include:

  • Demand generation strategy
  • SEO and digital acquisition
  • Email and lifecycle marketing
  • Webinars and industry events
  • Campaign development and execution


Your goal is to ensure marketing consistently generates qualified pipeline for the sales team.


Leading Blog and Thought Leadership Strategy

Own and grow the company’s blog and thought leadership presence to establish authority in the hospitality technology space and drive inbound demand.


This includes:

  • Writing and overseeing blog content focused on hotel industry trends and insights
  • Creating thought leadership around topics like AI in hospitality, guest engagement, and direct booking strategies
  • Developing SEO-driven blog content that attracts hotel decision-makers researching solutions
  • Implement AI Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure the company and its content are discoverable through AI agents like Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
  • Repurposing blog content into campaigns, LinkedIn posts, webinars, and sales materials


Creating Content That Speaks the Hotel Industry’s Language

title: Analista de sistemas
description:
Você é um profissional dinâmico e com espírito de crescimento? Então essa oportunidade é para você! 

Quem somos?


A Komanda F5 é uma empresa inovadora que vem ajudando negócios a digitalizar seus processos de vendas desde 2012. Com a implementação do nosso poderoso CRM Kommo , estamos impulsionando o crescimento de empresas ao redor do mundo, com sede na Rússia e Dubai e mais de 10.000 clientes na Europa Ocidental e América do Sul.

Estamos em busca de Analistas de Sistemas proativos e apaixonados por resultados, que queiram se desenvolver continuamente e fazer parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e engajada!


O que você fará?

  • Negociações e Correspondência Comercial : Interagir com clientes para promover nossos serviços e soluções.
  • Expansão de Assinaturas : Gerenciar e expandir as assinaturas de nossos clientes.
  • Gestão do CRM Kommo : Trabalhar com nossa plataforma para garantir que os clientes aproveitem ao máximo suas funcionalidades.
  • Documentação : Elaborar contratos e emitir notas fiscais.
  • Suporte ao Cliente : Ajudar nossos clientes com dúvidas e garantir uma experiência excelente.
  • Configuração de Contas : Ajustar as contas de nossos clientes para atender às suas necessidades específicas.


Quem buscamos?

  • Inglês intermediário (nível B1 ou superior).
  • Experiência de pelo menos 1 ano em vendas B2B .
  • Proficiência em português e inglês (avançado).
  • Perfil orientado a resultados, disciplinado e cheio de energia.
  • Habilidade para aprender de forma autônoma, grande capacidade de comunicação e motivação para buscar sempre o melhor desempenho.


O que oferecemos?

  • Treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades;
  • Salário U$600 USD + Comissão;
  • Trabalhar apenas com leads inbound ;
  • Acesso a um sistema de CRM fácil de usar e de alto impacto;
  • Um time motivado e sempre disposto a crescer junto com você;
  • Horário de segunda a sexta-feira, das 09:00 às 18:00.
  • 100% Remoto 


Se você é motivado, quer trabalhar em uma empresa global e está pronto para um desafio que pode gerar ótimos resultados financeiros e de crescimento profissional, venha fazer parte da Komanda F5 !

title: SAP S/4 HANA BRIM Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones SAP S/4 HANA BRIM)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.


KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

title: Brand Intern - Portuguese
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018.
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide.
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC.
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified.
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs.
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs.
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems.
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko.
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023.
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users.

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.

BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Internship| Long-term | REMOTE

Key Responsibilities

  • Support regional brand and marketing campaigns, including planning, coordination, and execution
  • Assist in brand content creation and localization, such as social media posts, blogs, PR materials, and campaign assets
  • Participate in social media planning, including content ideas, posting calendars, campaign themes, and basic execution support
  • Help track and organize campaign performance and brand metrics (e.g. media coverage, social performance, basic analytics)
  • Maintain and update brand assets and content libraries
  • Conduct market and competitor research to support brand strategy and regional insights
  • Provide general support for cross-team collaboration and communication


Requirements

  • Undergraduate or graduate student majoring in Marketing, Communications or related field
  • Strong interest in branding, marketing, and global communications
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English (additional languages are needed)
  • Familiar with social media platforms (X/Twitter, Instagram, Youtube, TikTok, etc.)
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment
  • Basic knowledge of Web3 / crypto / fintech is a plus, but not required



Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

Tipo de contratação: Tempo integral

Descrição da vaga

Estamos procurando um(a) Senior Account Manager para gerenciar relacionamentos com clientes e apoiar a coordenação de projetos de marketing e publicidade. Este profissional atuará como ponto de contato entre clientes e equipes internas, garantindo que as iniciativas sejam organizadas e executadas de forma eficiente.


Responsabilidades

Gerenciar e manter relacionamento com contas de clientes.

Compreender os objetivos dos clientes e apoiar a implementação de iniciativas de marketing.

Acompanhar o progresso de projetos e campanhas.

Monitorar resultados e preparar relatórios de desempenho quando necessário.

Colaborar com equipes de marketing, mídia e criação para garantir a execução das campanhas.


Requisitos

Experiência em gestão de contas, marketing, publicidade ou áreas relacionadas.

Boas habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento profissional.

Capacidade de organizar e acompanhar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.

Capacidade de trabalhar em colaboração com diferentes equipes.


Benefícios

Remuneração compatível com o mercado.

Ambiente de trabalho profissional e colaborativo.

Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
A US Academy of Esthetics é uma empresa de transição de vida profissional focada no direcionamento e certificação de profissionais da saúde (médicos e dentistas) por meio de programas premium com padrão americano para atuação na Harmonização Orofacial e Corporal.

Objetivo:

Estamos buscando um parceiro de marketing para:

  • Gerar leads qualificados (médicos e dentistas)
  • Vender programas de certificação high ticket
  • Construir autoridade internacional e posicionamento premium da marca

Escopo da oportunidade:

Esperamos suporte nas seguintes áreas:

  • Estratégia de funil (preferencialmente perpétuo)
  • Gestão de tráfego pago (Meta, Google e YouTube)
  • Copywriting (nível high ticket)
  • Estratégia de conteúdo (foco em autoridade, não apenas postagem)
  • Produção de conteúdo (diferencial, mas não obrigatório)

O que NÃO buscamos:

  • Estratégias voltadas para captação de pacientes
  • Gestão genérica de redes sociais
  • Foco em engajamento superficial (likes, seguidores, etc.)

O que esperamos:

  • Experiência comprovada com produtos high ticket
  • Experiência com educação, mentorias ou certificações
  • Domínio de funis de vendas e conversão
  • Abordagem orientada a dados (CAC, ROAS, LTV)
  • Proficiência em Inglês para se comunicar com nosso CEO

KPIs:

  • Custo por lead qualificado
  • Taxa de conversão
  • Custo de aquisição de cliente (CAC)
  • Retorno sobre investimento em mídia (ROAS)

Perguntas a responder na sua aplicação:

  • Quais produtos high ticket vocês já venderam?
  • Vocês trabalham com funil perpétuo ou lançamentos?
  • Quem é responsável pelo copywriting?
  • Quais canais de tráfego vocês operam?
  • Podem compartilhar cases com resultados mensuráveis?

NOTA DE POSICIONAMENTO:

Nosso posicionamento está mais próximo de:

Educação internacional premium (estilo Ivy League)

E NÃO de:

  • Marketing para clínicas ou captação de pacientes



REMUNERAÇÃO:

R$ 5.000,00 por mês

title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Job Title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)

Company : Elevated Tahoe Properties

Location : Remote


About Us

Elevated Tahoe Properties manages high-touch short-term rental and property portfolios focused on guest experience, operational excellence, and high-performing marketing that drives direct bookings. We’re hiring a proactive, creative, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our website, digital marketing, social media, and lead generation efforts.

Our Company Culture:

  • We are a fun, young company growing quickly
  • We value open communication and adding in humor whenever possible
  • Our team is self driven and empowered to handle their own responsibilities without being micromanaged
  • We inspire each other to become the best version of ourselves we can possibly become. 
  • We lead by example and use positive reinforcement to inspire others to strive for personal and professional greatness.

Role Summary

You will be responsible for helping us grow our online presence and increase direct vacation rental bookings through website updates, landing page creation, lead capture strategy, email marketing, and social media content support. This role requires strong design instincts, attention to detail, marketing experience, and a solid understanding of WordPress, Elementor, and basic website coding.


Key Responsibilities


  • Manage and update our WordPress website using Elementor
  • Build and optimize landing pages designed to drive bookings and capture leads
  • Improve website layout, visuals, and user experience to support conversion goals
  • Help increase traffic to the website through organic and campaign-based marketing efforts
  • Develop compelling, conversion-focused copywriting that incorporates SEO best practices for all web and marketing assets
  • Edit and prepare social media content including short-form video, photos, graphics, and captions
  • Schedule and publish social media posts across relevant platforms
  • Monitor inbound leads and help organize follow-up and lead nurturing workflows
  • Create and manage nurture email campaigns for existing guests, past guests, and new leads
  • Support list building, audience segmentation, and email campaign improvements
  • Assist with marketing asset creation for promotions, campaigns, and seasonal offers
  • Maintain brand consistency across website pages, email marketing, and social media content
  • Collaborate with leadership on ideas to improve direct bookings, lead generation, and guest engagement

Qualifications


  • Proven experience in digital marketing, website management, or lead generation
  • Strong hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor
  • Strong design skills with an eye for clean, polished, high-converting content
  • Experience editing social media video and photo content
  • Experience with email marketing platforms and nurture campaigns
  • Comfortable creating landing pages and understanding basic conversion strategy
  • Decent to strong website coding basics, including familiarity with HTML/CSS and light troubleshooting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple moving pieces
  • Able to work independently, take initiative, and bring creative solutions to the table
  • Familiarity with Asana or similar project management tools

Non‑Negotiable Requirements

  • Reliable backup power (UPS or generator) to prevent downtime during outages
  • Dual monitors for efficient multitasking
  • Backup internet (secondary wired connection or mobile hotspot) with stable speeds
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace and dependable computer 

Preferred

  • Experience with the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) or similar creative tools
  • Strong video editing proficiency for creating engaging short-form content
  • Deep understanding of social media marketing trends, algorithms, and best practices
  • Experience working with hospitality, vacation rentals, real estate, or travel brands

Required Days/Hours

  • Monday - Friday 8AM to 5PM Pacific Time (1 hour unpaid Lunch Break)


Compensation Target:

$950 per month + monthly KPI bonus / 40 hours per week — salary negotiable based on experience.

What We Offer

  • Remote role supporting a growing vacation rental and hospitality brand
  • Opportunity to directly impact bookings, lead generation, and brand growth
  • Creative, collaborative team environment with room to contribute ideas and improve systems


How to Apply (only email applications will be considered)


Email :

Subject : The Marketing & Website Coordinator Your Team Needs


Include:

  • Your Resume/CV
  • ONE OF (listed in order of preference):
  • A link to your personal portfolio website
  • A comprehensive PDF format portfolio document
  • At list of at least 5 links of design and marketing work you’ve completed
  • Pre-Screening Form:
  • Internet Speed Verification:

Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the speed test results.

  • DISC Assessment:

  Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the DISC assessment results graph.

  • A 2–3 minute video that includes:

-Brief intro and summary of your experience

-Why you’re the ideal candidate for this position

-Your top 3 skills that make you an excellent marketing and design coordinator


﻿Only applicants who follow these instructions exactly and demonstrate strong attention to detail will be considered.


Thank you and we look forward to working with you!


~ Elevated Tahoe Properties Team

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: GESTOR DE FUNIL
description:
LINK DO FORMULÁRIO PARA CADASTRAR-SE PARA VAGA:

Clique aqui > TypeformFaça parte do nosso time!

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Estruturar, organizar e otimizar funis de vendas de Direct Response (Front-end, Upsell, Downsell, Cross-sell e Order Bump);
  • Analisar métricas de conversão (CVR, AOV, CPA, LTV, lucro por lead);
  • Atualizar e consolidar indicadores de performance financeira dos funis (DRE por produto, margem, CMV, comissões e reembolsos);
  • Apoiar na montagem de projeções de fluxo de caixa por oferta;
  • Cruzar dados de diferentes plataformas (checkout, CRM, gateways de pagamento, afiliados);
  • Analisar cenários de preço (A/B), impacto em AOV, lucro por lead e taxas de reembolso;
  • Identificar gargalos de conversão e propor testes estruturados;
  • Coordenar melhorias de funil junto às áreas de Copy, Video, Tech, Produto e Backend;
  • Organizar roadmap de projetos de funil e garantir entregas dentro do prazo;
  • Validar integrações entre checkout, CRM, e-mail, SMS e webhooks;
  • Apoiar na preparação de relatórios operacionais para diretoria (margem por produto, lucro por lead, eficiência de funil, performance de ofertas);
  • Participar ativamente da definição de prioridades estratégicas com base em dados.

QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Experiência sólida com funis de vendas
  • Excel / Google Sheets avançado – uso de fórmulas complexas para manipulação de grandes bases de dados;
  • Experiência com métricas de performance digital (AOV, CPA, CVR, LTV);
  • Experiência com demonstrativos financeiros aplicados a marketing (DRE por produto, margem de contribuição);
  • Experiência com modelagem de cenários para tomada de decisão;
  • Conhecimento de integrações entre plataformas (checkout, CRM, gateways);
  • Elevado grau de responsabilidade com dados, indicadores e impacto financeiro;
  • Perfil analítico ativo: capacidade de interpretar resultados e propor soluções estratégicas.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de HTML e lógica básica de JavaScript (edição de scripts, botões e redirecionamentos), configuração de webhooks e familiaridade com pixels, UTMs e validação de eventos.
  • Capacidade de debugar problemas de funil em produção (redirecionamentos, integrações e tracking), com autonomia para resolver falhas técnicas sem depender constantemente do time de TI.
  • Diferencial :
  • Experiência com mercado internacional e afiliados.
  • Se fluente em inglês.

COMPETÊNCIAS:

  • PROATIVIDADE
  • ANALÍTICO
  • FOCO EM RESULTADO
  • ORGANIZAÇÃO
  • CAPACIDADE DE PRIORIZAÇÃO
  • RESOLUTIVO
  • COMUNICAÇÃO CLARA

SALÁRIO:

  • A combinar
  • Bônus trimestral - Vale a partir do segundo Trimestre dentro da empresa.

TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

  • A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.
  • 100% Home Office

COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:

  • Nossa comunicação é feita pelo discord, o candidato aprovado tem que estar disponível na plataforma para responder e se comunicar. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • Usamos o ClickUp para gerenciar as atividades da equipe. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • O candidato selecionado terá um período de três meses para ganhar experiência na empresa antes de ser efetivado na vaga

title: Consultor Protheus Financeiro/Contábil
description:
Perfil – Consultor Protheus Financeiro/Contábil (com Reforma Tributária)


Resumo do perfil:


Consultor funcional sênior com forte domínio dos módulos Financeiro (SIGAFIN) e Contábil (SIGACTB) do Protheus, com visão integrada dos processos empresariais e experiência comprovada em projetos de reforma tributária (nova legislação brasileira) .



Principais características:


  • Experiência sólida em:


  • Contas a pagar/receber
  • Fluxo de caixa
  • Conciliação bancária
  • Contabilidade geral e fiscal


  • Conhecimento em:


  • Integrações entre módulos (PMS, compras, faturamento)
  • Fechamento contábil
  • Regras fiscais brasileiras
  • Adequação sistêmica à reforma tributária (CBS/IBS, mudanças fiscais e impactos no ERP)


  • Capacidade de:


  • Mapear processos e corrigir inconsistências
  • Ajustar parametrizações críticas
  • Apoiar auditorias e melhorias de controle
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas fiscal, contábil e TI



Diferencial (agora obrigatório):


  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de reforma tributária (nova legislação)
  • Experiência em ambientes problemáticos (pós-implantação com inconsistências)

title: Performance Marketing Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Paid Media Marketing Specialist to drive high-quality leads by creating, managing, and measuring Digital Marketing campaigns across Google, YouTube, social, and other relevant channels.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on, independent strategic thinker who brings deep expertise in running digital marketing programs and developing digital marketing assets (with our designer) within B2B SaaS organizations.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive, this isn’t the role for you. But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own:

  • Develop programs and strategies for customer acquisition, retention, and expansion through multiple channels, including search, PMAX, social, retargeting, content (written and video), and more.
  • Define KPIs and implement measurement, analytics, benchmarking, and reporting methods to gauge success for marketing channels, campaigns, and initiatives.
  • Drive continual improvements in lead conversion rates and revenue close rates.
  • Continue to scale our marketing efforts and take primary responsibility for exceeding our KPIs for each quarter.
  • Work closely with the overall Marketing team to define required assets such as content, images, video, etc.

title: Analista de Requisitos Pleno
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Se você gosta de atuar na interface entre negócio e tecnologia, facilitando rituais ágeis e garantindo a evolução contínua de processos e sistemas...

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Requisitos Pleno com visão analítica, perfil colaborativo e forte atuação com stakeholders.

Se você domina gestão de backlog, mapeamento de processos e especificação técnica em ambientes integrados, essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como facilitador(a) dos rituais ágeis (daily, planning, review, retrospectiva), promovendo alinhamento entre os times
  • Intermediar a comunicação entre áreas de negócio, tecnologia e stakeholders externos
  • Monitorar o engajamento e a satisfação dos stakeholders, gerando reports executivos de acompanhamento
  • Identificar problemas, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e fluxos existentes
  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de demandas de TI em conjunto com as áreas de negócio
  • Elaborar especificações técnicas para correções e evoluções de sistemas
  • Atuar no processo de homologação técnica de demandas e projetos
  • Apoiar na resolução de conflitos e incidentes, garantindo a continuidade operacional
  • Mapear e documentar processos, propondo melhorias contínuas
  • Sugerir e aplicar práticas ágeis adequadas ao contexto (Scrum, Kanban, Design Thinking)


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Experiência como Analista de Requisitos, Negócios ou função similar
  • Forte atuação com gestão de backlog e priorização de demandas
  • Experiência em mapeamento e gestão de processos
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Design Thinking)
  • Conhecimento em especificação técnica de sistemas
  • Experiência com integrações via SOAP e REST
  • Conhecimento básico em SQL Server
  • Experiência com reports e acompanhamento de indicadores
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas do Office 365
  • Conhecimento em ambientes com sistemas integrados (APIs e barramentos)


Diferencial

  • Experiência com sistemas de Consórcio ou produtos financeiros
  • Conhecimento em Azure e arquitetura de APIs/Webservices
  • Vivência com fluxos de vendas e processos comerciais
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos e de grande escala
  • Certificação ou atuação prévia como Scrum Master


Formato de trabalho

  • 100% REMOTO.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

Local: Remoto (encontros presenciais em SP)

Startup de IA que automatiza testes de software para sistemas de missão crítica. Clientes como Stone, Ambev, Philips e Serasa. Investida por ONEVC, co-founder da Gupy, ex-CFO do Nubank, entre outros.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

Certifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Professional certifications are highly advantageous . Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM (for security management knowledge) or CEH, GIAC (for technical security skills). Vendor-specific certifications such as Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA are also valuable and demonstrate expertise in relevant technologies.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

Certifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Professional certifications are highly advantageous . Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM (for security management knowledge) or CEH, GIAC (for technical security skills). Vendor-specific certifications such as Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA are also valuable and demonstrate expertise in relevant technologies.

title: IT Specialist (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).

Compensation package - R$ 170 for 20 minutes online

title: Digital Content Producer
description:
DesignRush.com, a B2B Media Platform that drives brand discovery & growth, is seeking a Digital Content Producer to scale visual production and improve the performance of editorial content through stronger visual storytelling.

Our platform offers four key values to users:

  • Trending Brands: Brands can feature their expertise and achievements via news, interviews, and trends articles to get noticed and recognized as an industry leader.
  • Agency Rankings: Brands can view qualified agencies based on their expertise, location, clients, and various other factors.
  • Awards: Brands can enter their finest work and compete for the best web logo, app, print, packaging, and video design awards.
  • Marketplace: Businesses can post their projects at no cost and receive proposals from verified agencies.

The person in this role will be responsible for driving:

  • Production Scale and Publishing Efficiency: Produce and publish high-volume editorial content by creating and sourcing images, building infographics/motion graphics, formatting stories in the CMS, and maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Visual Performance and Conversion Impact: Improve article performance by creating visuals that reinforce the key message of each story and remain consistent with the brand identity, supported by optimized templates and motion/infographic enhancements.

We offer GROWTH, job stability, and a work culture that enables our teammates to excel in their careers.

This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position.

DesignRush is seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.

Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end story production (create/source visuals, infographic/motion builds, and CMS publishing) to support ~40 stories per week
  • Serve as the primary visual production point of contact for the content team, collaborating cross-functionally with dev, marketing, sales and digital PR, and collaborating with the head designer on template improvements and larger-scale design updates.
  • Continuously improve visual systems, templates and workflows to increase efficiency and engagement
  • Provide visual asset support across newsletters, digital PR, sales, and PTO coverage as needed

Required qualifications:

  • Over 5 years of proven hands-on experience in digital content production, visual storytelling, or editorial production roles .
  • Proven ability to manage high-volume publishing environments (30–40+ pieces of content per week).
  • Strong experience creating visual assets for editorial content , including Infographics, Data visualizations, Basic motion graphics or animated visuals, Image sourcing and editing
  • Proficiency with design and production tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects), or equivalent tools.
  • Experience publishing content in CMS platforms, including formatting, asset management, and QA.
  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling for digital media and SEO-driven content .
  • Experience working with design agencies or the creative industry
  • Strong understanding of marketing, branding, and digital agencies
  • Excellent written and oral English communication skills
  • Goal-oriented individual
  • Strong ability to strategize and solve problems
  • Able to work between 6 AM and 3 PM EST

Recruitment steps:

  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Receive a short questionnaire
  • Send back answers + CV
  • Have an interview with our Recruiter
  • Technical Test
  • Hiring Manager and our General Manager
  • Get feedback

We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

  • Strong experience creating visual assets for editorial content , including Infographics, Data visualizations, Basic motion graphics or animated visuals, Image sourcing and editing
  • Proficiency with design and production tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects), or equivalent tools.
  • Experience publishing content in CMS platforms, including formatting, asset management, and QA.
  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling for digital media and SEO-driven content .
  • Experience working with design agencies or the creative industry
  • Strong understanding of marketing, branding, and digital agencies
  • Excellent written and oral English communication skills
  • Goal-oriented individual
  • Strong ability to strategize and solve problems
  • Able to work between 6 AM and 3 PM EST

  • Have an interview with our Recruiter

title: Coordenador de Manutenção
description:
Para a posição de Coordenador de Manutenção, a atuação será voltada ao suporte das operações, com foco no acompanhamento de rotinas administrativas e operacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, programar e controlar as atividades de manutenção e grandes paradas de acordo com o programa de manutenção e com as prioridades operacionais;
  • Coordenar e garantir recursos humanos, materiais, peças, ferramentas e insumos necessários para a execução das tarefas de manutenção que necessitam do suporte de terra;
  • Ler e interpretar desenhos, esboços, tabelas, especificações técnicas, manuais ou instruções para validar ajustes, normas, tolerâncias e tudo que for necessário para execução do seu trabalho; Levantar fatos e dados relacionados a eventos para investigação (RCA);
  • Revisar e aprovar os serviços executados pelos fornecedores;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia de Produção, Mecânica, Automação, Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou Naval;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes;
  • Experiência no setor marítimo ou offshore.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em auditorias de sociedades classificadoras (ABS e DNV);
  • Conhecimento em Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção, Noções em Ciências navais e Navegação, Mecânica de propulsores e Lemes, Máquinas navais, Turbinas Sistemas de automação, Sistema de geração de energia, Sistemas hidráulicos, sistema de arrefecimento, Eletrônica, comunicação de rádios VHF e SSB e sistema Vsat;
  • Conhecimento em Serviços técnicos de produção, manutenção de sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos, vedações, montagens, conhecimento de sistemas offshore e operações dentro dos padrões técnicos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de causa raíz e/ou ferramentas de qualidade: 5W2H, diagrama de Ishikawa, diagrama de Pareto.

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $8000 USD per month


Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: ANALISTA DE AFILIADOS
description:

A XMX é uma empresa de nutracêuticos que opera com marketing digital de resposta direta , vendendo suplementos online.

  • Criar e manter um bom relacionamento com os afiliados.
  • Responder às dúvidas dos afiliados e fornecer suporte contínuo.

  • Treinamento e Capacitação para Afiliados
  • Acompanhamento de Performance

  • Experiência em Afiliados em Marketing Digital
  • Ter conhecimento comercial na área de afiliados
  • Ter conhecimento de Google Ads e Facebook Ads
  • Conhecimento de Sucesso Do Cliente
  • Ter experiência básica de Gestão de Equipe.


COMPETÊNCIAS:

  • PROATIVIDADE
  • COMUNICAÇÃO
  • INFLUÊNCIA
  • EXECUÇÃO
  • ORGANIZAÇÃO
  • ANALÍTICO

SALÁRIO:

  • Ser negociado

TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.

COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:

  • SEG a SEX - 9h as 18h

title: Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.   • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.

title: Consultor JD Edwards (JDE)
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Consultor Funcional de Finanças JD Edwards (JDE) para integrar a área Digital & IT, responsável por desenhar, configurar e implementar soluções no módulo financeiro do JDE

O profissional atuará na transformação do ambiente de ERP, trabalhando em ambiente internacional e multicultural, colaborando com stakeholders e equipes globais para entregar soluções integradas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.

Atuação abrangente nas etapas de Análise, Design, Codificação, Testes, Depuração e Suporte de aplicações corporativas.

Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações de negócios complexas , atuando em diferentes áreas funcionais .

Condução de revisões técnicas de design e código , com foco em qualidade, experiência do usuário, desempenho, escalabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções .

Experiência em projetos de rollout e expansão de sistemas , garantindo a implantação estruturada e aderente às necessidades do negócio.

Vivência em ambientes multiculturais , atuando em colaboração com equipes globais e distribuídas .


*Inglês fluente imprescindível

100% Remoto

Contratação CLT obrigatória

SKILL

Requires experience

• Functional experience/ Financial, Sales, Procurement, Distribution)

• Involved in all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle

• Analysis, Design, Coding, Testing, Debugging and Support of business

• Work with complicated business applications across functional areas

• Manage design and code reviews with a focus on the best user experience, performance, scalability and future expansion

• Previous experience in Rollout

• Experience working with global teams


Mandatory Skills

• JD Edwards with Finacne functional experience(Financial, Sales, Procurement, Distribution)

• Well versed with Brazil localization (ex: Tax reform etc)

• Fluent English speaking and writing

• Mapping business processes

• Knows technically the phases of the activities, identifies and guides in solving problems

• JD Edwards Versions E9.2


Recommended Skills

• Meet any needs of the customer service support to clarify doubts and correct BUGs;

• Analyse requests to define functional and how the development will be implemented

• Ability to interact with business users, understand business processes, and engineer solutions to business problems


Soft skills

• Very strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, enhancement, and maintenance skills

• Good communication and interpersonal skills

• Fluent English speaking and writing

• Fluent in Portuguese (local language of Brazil)


Degree

• Degree or higher


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Software Engineer in Test
description:
Remote

Contractor - PJ


Must Have:

  • Back end SDET with hands on coding skills
  • Playwright experience for validating workflows from login to transaction completion on browsers
  • Java development on very complex legacy applications
  • Heavy API testing in a framework (Rest Assured, an API framework)
  • Schema validation, end point validation
  • Experience with any JVM based language (Scala, Groovy, Closure)
  • Someone who has done peer coding and peer reviews to improve the ecosystem
  • Large enterprise environment


Plus:

  • Rest Assured
  • Groovy
  • Scala
  • Local to Mexico City

D2D:

This SDET will be working on a project at a global hotel chain to replace their reservation system. The current system is a green screen terminal application that is over 40 years old. It needs to switch to a software as a service to handle the reservations. It will require all of the functionality from the tests on the old system to work on the new system via software as a service. This will be mostly back end and API testing, with hands on Java coding. They will work on a development team of engineers, developers, designers, and product owners. They will do peer reviews of coding and will work collaboratively with other SDETs. Must be expert level in Java development.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil. Based)

Reports to: QA Engineer Senior

Type: Full-time

Salary : Competitive open to negotiate payment USD

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to join our growing technology team for an important Fintech Crypto Company. This role is crucial in ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of our software products.

You will be responsible for executing manual and automated tests, identifying and documenting issues, and creating test scenarios aligned with business and technical requirements. You’ll also contribute to improving QA processes, CI/CD integration, and leveraging AI technologies to enhance automation efficiency and coverage.

This is a hands-on position — ideal for someone who enjoys both technical testing and process improvement , and who thrives in a collaborative, Agile environment.

⚙️ Key Responsibilities

  • Execute manual and automated tests to ensure software quality and performance.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases based on business requirements.
  • Create and manage functional and regression tests across multiple platforms.
  • Identify, document, and track issues and inconsistencies; collaborate with developers for timely resolution.
  • Support and promote best quality assurance practices within the development team.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to support continuous delivery.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve QA processes, tools, and methodologies .
  • Provide clear reporting on testing progress, risks, and software quality metrics.
  • Utilize AI-based tools to enhance test creation, automation scripting, and defect detection.
  • Collaborate closely with product owners, developers, and stakeholders to ensure alignment with user expectations.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, with 2+ years in automation testing.
  • Proven experience in manual and automated testing within an Agile environment.
  • Strong background in designing and executing detailed test plans and defect management .
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows .

Technical Skills

  • Advanced English level (C1 ).
  • Proficiency with testing frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright .
  • Familiarity with AI tools for generating or optimizing test scripts.
  • Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).
  • Understanding of REST APIs, SQL , and general software testing methodologies.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices and ability to collaborate in iterative development cycles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright .
  • Exposure to AI-based test automation or intelligent test generation tools.
  • Experience with cloud-based environments and microservices testing.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools .

Why Join Us

  • Work with cutting-edge QA and AI technologies in a fast-paced environment.
  • Join a collaborative, innovation-driven engineering culture .
  • Competitive compensation and long-term growth opportunities .
  • Opportunity to contribute to high-impact, scalable software solutions .

title: Coordenador(a) de Trade Marketing
description:
Nosso cliente, uma empresa nacional de grande relevância no setor alimentício busca um(a) Coordenador(a) Trade Marketing para atuar na categoria de perecíveis, com foco em execução estratégica, gestão de PDV e suporte às equipes comercial e de marketing.


Responsabilidades


Planejamento & Estratégia

  • Desenvolver o plano anual de Trade Marketing para a categoria, alinhado às metas comerciais.
  • Analisar consumidor, mercado e tendências para propor ações que aumentem presença, visibilidade e frequência de compra.
  • Contribuir para definições de sortimento e estratégia por canal.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar o trabalho dos promotores, incluindo treinamento e direcionamento.
  • Apoiar ativações e campanhas junto ao time de Marketing.


Execução no PDV

  • Criar e implementar campanhas sazonais e materiais de ponto de venda (expositores, wobblers, comunicação de preço etc.).
  • Garantir padronização da execução nas lojas, monitorando rupturas, giro e competitividade.


Relacionamento com Varejo e Distribuição

  • Atuar como interface entre Comercial, Marketing e clientes, assegurando a implementação das ações de trade.
  • Negociar pontos extras, espaços de destaque e oportunidades de visibilidade.
  • Oferecer suporte à equipe de vendas com materiais, argumentos e treinamentos.


Análises & Indicadores

  • Acompanhar KPIs como sell-in, sell-out, ruptura, estoque, margem e participação de gôndola.
  • Produzir relatórios de desempenho por canal, cliente e SKU, trazendo insights para decisões comerciais.


Gestão de Budget

  • Administrar o orçamento de Trade Marketing, controlar investimentos, custos de materiais e verbas cooperadas.
  • Garantir compliance e acompanhamento de ROI.


Desenvolvimento de Categoria

  • Sugerir melhorias de exposição, embalagens, layout e diferenciação da categoria, considerando atributos como frescor, origem, certificações e valor agregado.


Requisitos

  • Formação em Marketing, Publicidade, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Trade Marketing, preferencialmente em alimentos perecíveis ou bens de consumo de alto giro.
  • Conhecimento de varejo, atacarejo e/ou food service.
  • Boa capacidade analítica e domínio de ferramentas como Excel e Power BI.
  • Perfil organizado, comunicativo e com habilidade de negociação e relacionamento.

title: ASM Team Lead
description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead the ASM team in daily coordination, prioritization, and escalation management.
  • Conduct triage for high visibility incidents, ensuring clear and timely communication with IT and Business.
  • Prioritize incidents and changes together with Business teams and IT capabilities.
  • Manage multi-vendor relationships, ensuring high performance and delivery quality.
  • Review ticket flow per portfolio and monitor RCA, weekly meetings, and performance metrics.
  • Translate business problems into technical requirements to accelerate resolution.
  • Perform code reviews and validate release packages and installation plans.
  • Coordinate operational artifacts: Stability Assessment, knowledge documents, KEDB, and Service Delivery reports.
  • Actively participate in Command Center and Incident/Problem/RCA Management forums.
  • Lead productivity initiatives and preventive maintenance programs.
  • Ensure compliance with processes and controls, applying ITIL/ SDLC best practices.
  • Present monthly results (KPIs/SLAs) to IT and Business leadership.
  • Support operational activities when necessary.


Success Indicators (KPIs)

  • Application availability and stability (uptime).
  • MTTR reduction and incident recurrence reduction.
  • SLA/SLO performance.
  • Change quality (low rollback/post release incident rate).
  • Operational efficiency: backlog reduction, productivity improvements, automation.
  • Internal customer satisfaction (IT/Business).


Mandatory Requirements

  • 8+ years leading IT solution delivery (ASM, AMS, Application Operations, or related fields).
  • Proven experience in critical incident management, prioritization, and executive communication.
  • Experience with multi-vendor environments and enterprise ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft).
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL (Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge) and SDLC.
  • Ability to mentor teams, run operational ceremonies, and present operational metrics.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (Computer Science, Systems, Engineering, Business/Finance).
